page_title: STR 0-0 BRE | Strasbourg v Brest 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' What a poor attempt! Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
90+1' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) replacing Ismael Doukoure.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Edimilson Fernandes (Brest) has replaced Mathias Pereira Lage.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Serigne Diop (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Magnetti.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

89' Marco Bizot was forced into action to thwart Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
87' Djordje Petrovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Romain Faivre (Brest) after a cross from the side.
87' Mahdi Camara (Brest) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
86' Romain Faivre (Brest) takes the corner kick, but Djordje Petrovic reads it well and stops the effort.
82' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
81' Marco Bizot is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg). Easy save!
78' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Brest get a free kick.
77' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Felix Lemarechal and he is replaced by Sekou Mara (Strasbourg).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mama Balde leaves the pitch and Romain Faivre (Brest) comes on.
76' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
75' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brest are going to take it.
74' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
73' Mahdi Camara (Brest) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
69' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
69' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
68' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
67' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Djordje Petrovic, who smothers the ball.
66' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
64' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
64' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Bizot intercepts the ball.
59' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Kamory Doumbia is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
59' Valentin Barco goes off the pitch and Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) comes on.
59' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
58' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Clement Turpin saw the whole situation. There is a free kick near the sideline to Strasbourg.
57' The corner from Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is intercepted by the defence.
56' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.

56' Mahdi Camara (Brest) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
54' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) heads on.
49' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
48' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Eric Roy decided to make a change. Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) is replaced by Abdoulaye Ndiaye.
46' Referee Clement Turpin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
41' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Marco Bizot is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
38' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest), but it's just wide of the right post.
37' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
37' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
33' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
33' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger. It will be a corner kick for Brest.
31' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
27' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
26' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
25' The referee blows his whistle as Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was too aggressive in his challenge.
24' Massadio Haidara (Brest) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
20' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' A rebound falls at the feet of Mama Balde (Brest) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
18' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
15' The goal by Strasbourg won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
14' The Strasbourg players joy may have been justified, because referee Clement Turpin is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
14' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
13' The game is interrupted as Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is flagged offside.
8' Brest are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
6' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
3' Kenny Lala (Brest) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
2' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Strasbourg will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will supervise the game today.
